category_title: Pre-engaged students with organizational and focus challenges
minimal_context: The student is reading texts out loud during a reading curriculum activity to practice decoding and comprehension.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read this text out loud for me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Eager to learn, reads the text out loud at a very high speed) I finished it!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. What did the text mean?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes an inappropriate attempt to participate by shouting a random guess) It's about a car! Wait, no. Can I just read the next page?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this page again. Tell me what happened in the story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts reading the text again at high speed) I can read it really fast, but I do not really understand the meanings.

task.content: decoding tasks at high speeds (80-90 words per minute)
